description.zh: 要删除的应用接入点的名称。
description.en: The name of the AAP that you want to delete.

descriptions.zh:
- RAM用户或RAM角色调用该OpenAPI需要被授予的权限策略详情，请参见[访问控制](~~2767210~~)。

- 删除前请确保该应用接入点已不再使用，否则会导致相关应用无法正常访问KMS，请谨慎操作。
descriptions.en:
- For information about the access policy that a RAM user or RAM role requires to call this operation, see [Resource Access Management](~~2767210~~).

- Before you delete an AAP, make sure that it is no longer in use. If you delete an AAP that is in use, related applications cannot access KMS. Proceed with caution.
